VAL_source.30: predictive_splits_30d.csv VAL at 2010-08-01; validation-vintage purchase model available by 2010-06-30.
VAL_source.60: predictive_splits_60d.csv VAL at 2010-07-01; validation-vintage purchase model available by 2010-06-30.
VAL_source.90: predictive_splits_60d.csv VAL features at 2010-07-01; validation-vintage P90 probabilities only, with no validation outcomes used to choose bins.

known_limitations: The final 90-day spending model has no eligible prospective validation vintage; TEST revenue results are retrospective.
The 90-day probability-bin edges use a validation-vintage July 1 probability distribution; no validation outcomes select the bins.
Fixed-model bootstrap intervals quantify empirical group-metric uncertainty, not model-parameter or individual-outcome uncertainty.
Feature-range flags are TRAIN reference-support diagnostics, not model-failure probabilities.
reference_profile_definition: Training-only feature medians and deterministic lexical mode, calculated from the exact saved model training split after applying its saved TRAIN-fitted segmentation transform.
